title: Pulse Play YoloBox overlay config
description: One document for every ground. Ads and logos share the assets list (kind ad or logo). Uploaded bytes are not in this document: src is a site path, an idb: key, or a Storage public URL.

poll_ms.description: How often a renderer re-reads the config when a Realtime update is missed. 2 to 300 seconds. Default 2000.

auto_return_on_end.description: Kept for older documents. The renderer ignores it. Every video returns to Logos + Score when it finishes.

assets.description: Shared library. kind ad is an MP4 or a still image (PNG, JPG, or a PDF page saved as PNG). kind logo is a PNG, WebP, SVG, or JPG.

src.description: Playable or displayable URL: site path, idb:<key>, or a Storage public URL.

storage_path.description: Repo path, idb key, or object path inside the pulseplay-assets bucket.

media_type.description: Ads only. image stays on screen until switched. video always returns to Logos + Score when it finishes.

logo_scale.description: Logos only. Multiplies the ground slot scale. Null is 100%.

logos.description: Asset ids from the library, not raw URLs.

id.description: Stable id. The renderer URL is ?ground=<id>&device=pro|mini.

short_link.description: The one short URL loaded by the YoloBox for this ground.

resolved_url.description: GitHub Pages URL the short link redirects to.

device.description: Both Pro and Mini use a 1920x1080 stage. mini.css only enlarges logos and type for the Mini's smaller panel.

mode.description: logos_score is View 1. ad is View 2 and uses active_ad.

active_ad.description: Ad id while mode is ad. null on View 1.

score_url.description: CricClubs overlay URL for this ground. The renderer and Command Center both iframe this field.

layout.description: Optional per-slot scale (0.25 to 2) and x/y nudge in stage pixels. Null uses the device base sizes.

ad_ids.description: Ads from the library that the control view may play at this ground.
